labels.animation-conflicts.filter.note: Lower-case noun filling {what} in the warning 'Overrides {name}: both animate the {what}'. It names the CSS filter property (blur, brightness). Keep it lower case and a noun.

labels.animation-conflicts.glow.note: Lower-case noun filling {what} in the warning 'Overrides {name}: both animate the {what}'. It names the soft light around an element. Keep it lower case.

labels.animation-conflicts.opacity.note: Lower-case noun filling {what} in the warning 'Overrides {name}: both animate the {what}'. It names how see-through an element is. Keep it lower case.

labels.animation-conflicts.position.note: Lower-case noun filling {what} in the warning 'Overrides {name}: both animate the {what}'. It names where an element sits (it moves). Keep it lower case.

labels.animation-conflicts.rotation.note: Lower-case noun filling {what} in the warning 'Overrides {name}: both animate the {what}'. It names turning an element around its centre. Keep it lower case.

labels.animation-conflicts.scale.note: Lower-case noun filling {what} in the warning 'Overrides {name}: both animate the {what}'. It names making an element bigger or smaller, not a measuring scale.

labels.animation-list.overrides-name-bot.note: Warning under an animation in the list. {name} is the name of an earlier animation, such as Pulse; {what} is the visual property both animate, such as scale, glow or rotation.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.
vars.what: The value that replaces what in the text.

labels.animation-presets.3d-rotate.note: Name of an animation preset in the picker: the element turns in three dimensions. Keep it short.

labels.animation-presets.angle.note: Field label for a preset setting: the angle in degrees the effect turns or tilts by.

labels.animation-presets.aura.note: Name of an animation preset in the picker: a soft coloured halo around the element.

labels.animation-presets.aurora.note: Name of a background animation preset: slow shifting bands of colour like the northern lights.

labels.animation-presets.autumn.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset (season, not the verb): warm autumn colours and falling leaves.

labels.animation-presets.backgrounds.note: Group heading in the animation preset picker, plural: presets that animate the card or module background.

labels.animation-presets.bars.note: Name of an animation preset in the picker, plural: vertical bars that rise and fall like a level meter.

labels.animation-presets.beam-width.note: Field label for a preset setting: how wide the light beam is (for example in the spotlight or radar sweep).

labels.animation-presets.blink.note: Name of an animation preset in the picker: the element switches on and off sharply.

labels.animation-presets.bokeh.note: Name of a background animation preset: soft out-of-focus discs of light drifting about (photography term).

labels.animation-presets.border-snake.note: Name of a border animation preset: a short bright line that travels around the border.

labels.animation-presets.border-width.note: Field label for a preset setting: thickness of the animated border line.

labels.animation-presets.borders.note: Group heading in the animation preset picker, plural: presets that animate the border.

labels.animation-presets.bounce.note: Name of an animation preset in the picker: the element hops up and down like a ball.

labels.animation-presets.breathe.note: Name of an animation preset in the picker (verb): the element slowly grows and shrinks like breathing.

labels.animation-presets.breathing-borde.note: Name of a border animation preset: the border slowly brightens and fades in a steady rhythm.

labels.animation-presets.brightness.note: Field label for a preset setting: how much brighter the element gets at the peak of the effect.

labels.animation-presets.bubbles.note: Name of a background animation preset, plural: bubbles rising through the background.

labels.animation-presets.charging-stripe.note: Name of a bar animation preset: diagonal stripes move along a bar like a battery charging.

labels.animation-presets.christmas.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset: festive Christmas decoration. Use the usual local name of the holiday.

labels.animation-presets.clouds.note: Name of a weather-style animation preset, plural: clouds float across the background.

labels.animation-presets.clouds-drift.note: Name of a background animation preset: clouds drifting slowly sideways ('drift' is a verb here).

labels.animation-presets.cloudy.note: Name of a weather scene preset (adjective): an overcast sky. Matches the weather condition of the same name.

labels.animation-presets.coin-spin.note: Name of an animation preset: the element spins on its vertical axis like a coin.

labels.animation-presets.colour-cycle-ba.note: Name of a background preset: the background fades through a cycle of colours.

labels.animation-presets.confetti.note: Name of a celebration particle preset: coloured paper pieces falling.

labels.animation-presets.conic-border-sp.note: Name of a border preset: a cone-shaped colour sweep (conic gradient) rotates around the border.

labels.animation-presets.day-and-night.note: Name of a scene preset: the background shifts between a day sky and a night sky.

labels.animation-presets.density.note: Field label for a preset setting: how many particles or drops are on screen at once.

labels.animation-presets.depth.note: Field label for a preset setting: how far the effect appears to move in or out (3D depth).

labels.animation-presets.dim.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element fades to a darker level and back.

labels.animation-presets.distance.note: Field label for a preset setting: how far the element moves, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.dot-size.note: Field label for a preset setting: the diameter of each dot.

labels.animation-presets.dots.note: Name of an animation preset, plural: small dots that move or pulse.

labels.animation-presets.drip.note: Name of an animation preset: drops run down from the top edge.

labels.animation-presets.dusk-glow.note: Name of a scene preset: a warm evening glow at twilight.

labels.animation-presets.ease.note: Option in the timing (easing) list: the default CSS ease curve. Keep the CSS term.

labels.animation-presets.ease-in.note: Option in the timing (easing) list: starts slowly, then speeds up. Not an instruction to the user.

labels.animation-presets.ease-in-out.note: Option in the timing (easing) list: slow at both start and end, faster in the middle.

labels.animation-presets.ease-out.note: Option in the timing (easing) list: starts fast, then slows down at the end.

labels.animation-presets.easter.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset for the Easter holiday.

labels.animation-presets.equalizer-bars.note: Name of an animation preset: bars jump up and down like an audio equaliser.

labels.animation-presets.fade.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element fades in and out. Also appears as a tab content option.

labels.animation-presets.fade-pulse.note: Name of an animation preset: opacity pulses gently up and down.

labels.animation-presets.falling-leaves.note: Name of a particle preset: leaves drifting down the background.

labels.animation-presets.fast-spin.note: Name of an animation preset: the element rotates quickly, for example an icon on a fan.

labels.animation-presets.fill-level.note: Name of a bar preset: a liquid-like fill that follows the bar value (noun).

labels.animation-presets.fireflies.note: Name of a particle preset, plural: tiny glowing lights drifting and blinking (the insects).

labels.animation-presets.fireworks.note: Name of a celebration particle preset: bursts of light in the background.

labels.animation-presets.flame-flicker.note: Name of an animation preset: warm light that flickers like a candle flame.

labels.animation-presets.flicker.note: Name of an animation preset: brightness flickers irregularly, like a failing bulb.

labels.animation-presets.flip.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element flips over like a card.

labels.animation-presets.float.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element bobs gently up and down. Not the CSS float property.

labels.animation-presets.foggy.note: Name of a weather scene preset (adjective): drifting fog. Matches the weather condition.

labels.animation-presets.glitch.note: Name of an animation preset: the element jitters and splits like a faulty digital signal.

labels.animation-presets.glow.note: Name of an animation preset (noun): a soft light that brightens around the element.

labels.animation-presets.glow-pulse.note: Name of an animation preset: the glow pulses stronger and weaker. Differs from 'Glow & pulse'.

labels.animation-presets.glow-pulse-2.note: Group heading in the preset picker for glow and pulse effects. Differs from the preset 'Glow pulse'.

labels.animation-presets.glow-size.note: Field label for a preset setting: how far the glow spreads, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.gradient-flow.note: Name of a background preset: a colour gradient that slides slowly across the background.

labels.animation-presets.halloween.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset for the Halloween holiday.

labels.animation-presets.halo-ripple.note: Name of an animation preset: rings of light spread outwards from the element like a halo.

labels.animation-presets.head-shake.note: Name of an animation preset: a quick side-to-side shake, like shaking the head for 'no'.

labels.animation-presets.heartbeat.note: Name of an animation preset: two quick pulses then a pause, like a heart beating.

labels.animation-presets.heat-shimmer.note: Name of an animation preset: a wavy haze like hot air rising.

labels.animation-presets.height.note: Field label for a preset setting: how tall the effect is, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.holographic-shi.note: Name of an animation preset: a rainbow sheen that shifts across the surface like a hologram.

labels.animation-presets.hue-range.note: Field label for a preset setting: how many degrees of the colour wheel the hue shifts across.

labels.animation-presets.interaction.note: Group heading in the preset picker: effects that play when the user taps, presses or hovers.

labels.animation-presets.jello.note: Name of an animation preset: the element wobbles like jelly (dessert). Any playful word is fine.

labels.animation-presets.lava-lamp.note: Name of a background preset: slow blobs of colour rise and merge like in a lava lamp.

labels.animation-presets.lift.note: Name of an interaction preset (verb): the element rises slightly on hover or press.

labels.animation-presets.light-colour.note: Group heading in the preset picker for effects that change light and colour.

labels.animation-presets.lightning.note: Name of a weather preset: sudden flashes of lightning.

labels.animation-presets.linear.note: Option in the timing (easing) list: constant speed from start to end.

labels.animation-presets.liquid-wave.note: Name of a bar or background preset: a wavy liquid surface that moves.

labels.animation-presets.live-weather.note: Name of a preset that follows the current weather entity and shows matching conditions.

labels.animation-presets.marching-ants.note: Name of a border preset: a dashed outline whose dashes crawl around the edge (selection-box style).

labels.animation-presets.matrix-rain.note: Name of a background preset: columns of green characters falling, in the style of a hacker film.

labels.animation-presets.meteor-shower.note: Name of a night-sky preset: streaks of light cross the background.

labels.animation-presets.motion.note: Group heading in the preset picker for effects that move or shake the element.

labels.animation-presets.neon-border.note: Name of a border preset: a glowing neon-tube outline.

labels.animation-presets.neon-flicker.note: Name of an animation preset: a neon sign that flickers on and off.

labels.animation-presets.new-year.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset for New Year celebrations.

labels.animation-presets.night-sky.note: Name of a scene preset: a dark sky with twinkling stars.

labels.animation-presets.ocean-waves.note: Name of a background preset: layered sea waves rolling along the bottom.

labels.animation-presets.offset.note: Field label for a preset setting: how far the effect is shifted from its normal position, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.orbit.note: Name of an animation preset (noun or verb): a light circles the element.

labels.animation-presets.orbit-dots.note: Name of an animation preset: small dots circle around the element.

labels.animation-presets.particles.note: Group heading in the preset picker, plural: effects made of many tiny moving shapes.

labels.animation-presets.pendulum.note: Name of an animation preset: the element swings back and forth like a clock pendulum.

labels.animation-presets.ping.note: Name of an animation preset: a ring expands and fades like a sonar ping. Not a network ping.

labels.animation-presets.plasma-gradient.note: Name of a background preset: swirling, shifting colour blends like a plasma effect.

labels.animation-presets.playful.note: Group heading in the preset picker (adjective): lively, bouncy effects.

labels.animation-presets.pop.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element quickly grows and settles back.

labels.animation-presets.power-flow-dots.note: Name of a preset: dots travel along a line to show energy flowing (power as in electricity).

labels.animation-presets.press.note: Name of an interaction preset (verb): the element sinks slightly when pressed.

labels.animation-presets.radar-sweep.note: Name of an animation preset: a beam rotates like a radar screen.

labels.animation-presets.radius.note: Field label for a preset setting: the radius of the effect circle, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.rain-fall.note: Name of a particle preset: raindrops falling (noun phrase, 'rain' plus 'fall').

labels.animation-presets.rainbow-hue.note: Name of an animation preset: colours cycle through the rainbow.

labels.animation-presets.rainy.note: Name of a weather scene preset (adjective). Matches the weather condition of the same name.

labels.animation-presets.ray-width.note: Field label for a preset setting: how wide each sun ray is.

labels.animation-presets.ring-size.note: Field label for a preset setting: the diameter of each ring, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.rings.note: Name of an animation preset, plural: circles that expand outwards.

labels.animation-presets.rings-sweeps.note: Group heading in the preset picker for ring and sweeping-beam effects.

labels.animation-presets.ripple-rings.note: Name of an animation preset: rings spread like ripples on water.

labels.animation-presets.ripples.note: Group heading in the preset picker, plural: ripple-style effects.

labels.animation-presets.rotation.note: Group heading in the preset picker for turning effects. Different from the lower-case 'rotation' in conflict warnings.

labels.animation-presets.rubber-band.note: Name of an animation preset: the element stretches and snaps back like an elastic band.

labels.animation-presets.rumble.note: Name of an animation preset: a low, rapid vibration of the element.

labels.animation-presets.scale.note: Field label for a preset setting: how much bigger the element gets (a factor, such as 1.2). Not a measuring scale.

labels.animation-presets.scanline.note: Name of an animation preset: a thin bright line sweeps over the element like an old monitor.

labels.animation-presets.scenes.note: Group heading in the preset picker, plural: full background scenes such as night sky or dusk.

labels.animation-presets.seasonal.note: Group heading in the preset picker (adjective): effects for seasons and holidays.

labels.animation-presets.shadow-lift.note: Name of an interaction preset: the shadow deepens so the element seems to lift off the card.

labels.animation-presets.shake-alert.note: Name of an animation preset: the element shakes to draw attention to an alert.

labels.animation-presets.shine.note: Name of an animation preset (noun): a glossy highlight on the element.

labels.animation-presets.shine-sweep.note: Name of an animation preset: a glossy highlight sweeps across the element.

labels.animation-presets.smoke.note: Name of a particle preset: wisps of smoke rising.

labels.animation-presets.smooth.note: Option for the character of a motion (adjective): gentle, flowing movement.

labels.animation-presets.snap.note: Option for the character of a motion: quick, abrupt movement with no easing.

labels.animation-presets.snow-fall.note: Name of a particle preset: snowflakes falling (noun phrase).

labels.animation-presets.snowy.note: Name of a weather scene preset (adjective). Matches the weather condition of the same name.

labels.animation-presets.sparks.note: Name of a particle preset, plural: bright sparks flying off the element.

labels.animation-presets.spin.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element rotates continuously.

labels.animation-presets.spotlight.note: Name of an animation preset: a pool of light follows or sweeps across the element.

labels.animation-presets.spring.note: Ambiguous: either the season (seasonal preset) or a springy easing; here it is the season, like Autumn and Winter.

labels.animation-presets.squash.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element flattens briefly, then recovers.

labels.animation-presets.squash-stretch.note: Name of an animation preset: the element alternately flattens and elongates like a cartoon ball.

labels.animation-presets.starfield.note: Name of a background preset: stars streaming past as if flying through space.

labels.animation-presets.steam-rise.note: Name of a particle preset: steam rising upwards (noun phrase).

labels.animation-presets.storm-flash.note: Name of a weather preset: a brief flash of light, as in a thunderstorm.

labels.animation-presets.streams.note: Group heading in the preset picker, plural: flowing lines or dots moving along a path.

labels.animation-presets.strength.note: Field label for a preset setting: how strong or visible the effect is.

labels.animation-presets.stretch.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element elongates briefly. Differs from the CSS align option 'Stretch'.

labels.animation-presets.stripe-strength.note: Field label for a preset setting: how visible the moving stripes are.

labels.animation-presets.summer.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset (season): bright, warm summer look.

labels.animation-presets.sun-rays.note: Name of a weather scene preset: rays of sunlight turning slowly.

labels.animation-presets.sunny.note: Name of a weather scene preset (adjective). Matches the weather condition of the same name.

labels.animation-presets.sway.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element leans gently from side to side.

labels.animation-presets.swing.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element swings from its top edge like a sign.

labels.animation-presets.tada.note: Name of an animation preset: a celebratory shake and zoom, like 'ta-da!'. An informal word is fine.

labels.animation-presets.tap-ripple.note: Name of an interaction preset: a ripple spreads from the point where the user taps.

labels.animation-presets.thunderstorm.note: Name of a weather scene preset: dark clouds, rain and lightning. Matches the weather condition.

labels.animation-presets.tilt.note: Name of an interaction preset (verb): the element leans in 3D, following the pointer.

labels.animation-presets.twinkle.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): small lights flicker softly like stars.

labels.animation-presets.typing-dots.note: Name of an animation preset: three dots that pulse in turn, like a chat 'typing' indicator.

labels.animation-presets.valentine.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset for Valentine's Day, with hearts.

labels.animation-presets.water-ripple.note: Name of a background preset: ripples spread over a water surface.

labels.animation-presets.wave-height.note: Field label for a preset setting: how tall the waves are, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.weather-device.note: Group heading in the preset picker for weather scenes and device-state effects.

labels.animation-presets.width.note: Field label for a preset setting: how wide the effect is, in pixels.

labels.animation-presets.wiggle.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element wiggles from side to side.

labels.animation-presets.wind-lines.note: Name of a weather preset: thin streaks blowing across the background.

labels.animation-presets.windy.note: Name of a weather scene preset (adjective). Matches the weather condition of the same name.

labels.animation-presets.winter.note: Name of a seasonal animation preset (season): a cold, snowy look.

labels.animation-presets.wobble.note: Name of an animation preset (verb): the element wobbles unsteadily.

labels.bar-module.bar.note: Name of the progress bar module in the module picker.

labels.bar-module.display-a-progress-bar.text: Display a progress bar based on entity state
labels.bar-module.display-a-progress-bar.note: One-line description of the progress bar module in the module picker.

labels.button-module.button.note: Name of the button module in the module picker.

labels.button-module.interactive-button-.text: Interactive button with icon, label, and optional state display
labels.button-module.interactive-button-.note: One-line description of the button module in the module picker.

labels.card-settings.backdrop-filter.note: Card settings field label for the blur or tint behind the card (CSS backdrop-filter).

labels.card-settings.border-colour.note: Card settings field label for the colour of the whole card's border.

labels.card-settings.border-style.note: Card settings field label for the line style (solid, dashed) of the card's border.

labels.card-settings.border-width.note: Card settings field label for the thickness of the card's border.

labels.card-settings.margin.note: Card settings field label for the space outside the card's edge (CSS margin).

labels.css-properties.a-truncated-label-.text: A truncated label ends in an ellipsis and shows in full as a tooltip.
labels.css-properties.a-truncated-label-.note: Hint under the Label overflow option in the CSS panel; a full sentence, keep the word ellipsis.

labels.css-properties.above.note: Position option: the element sits above the other part (icon above text, state above label).

labels.css-properties.advanced.note: Group heading for rarely used CSS fields; collapsed by default.

labels.css-properties.align-content.note: CSS property name (align-content): how several rows or lines share spare space across the cross axis.

labels.css-properties.align-items.note: CSS property name (align-items): how children line up across the cross axis of a flex or grid container.

labels.css-properties.align-self.note: CSS property name (align-self): cross-axis alignment for this one element, overriding its container.

labels.css-properties.alignment.note: Group heading for the alignment fields (align, justify) in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.all.note: Option that applies a value to every side or every property at once.

labels.css-properties.animation-delay.note: CSS field label (animation-delay): wait before a CSS animation starts.

labels.css-properties.animation-directio.note: CSS field label (animation-direction): forwards, reverse or alternating playback.

labels.css-properties.animation-duration.note: CSS field label (animation-duration): how long one animation cycle lasts.

labels.css-properties.animation-name.note: CSS field label (animation-name): which keyframes animation to play.

labels.css-properties.animation-timing.note: CSS field label (animation-timing-function): the easing curve of a CSS animation.

labels.css-properties.animations.note: Group heading for the CSS animation fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.area.note: CSS grid field label (grid-area): the named region or cell span an element occupies.

labels.css-properties.auto.note: Option meaning the browser decides the value (CSS auto).

labels.css-properties.auto-columns.note: CSS grid field label (grid-auto-columns): width of columns created automatically.

labels.css-properties.auto-flow.note: CSS grid field label (grid-auto-flow): whether items fill the grid by row or by column.

labels.css-properties.auto-rows.note: CSS grid field label (grid-auto-rows): height of rows created automatically.

labels.css-properties.backdrop-filter.note: CSS field label (backdrop-filter): blur or tint applied behind an element.

labels.css-properties.background.note: CSS field label for the background shorthand (colour, image and more in one value).

labels.css-properties.background-attachm.note: CSS field label (background-attachment): whether the background scrolls with the page or stays fixed.

labels.css-properties.background-clip.note: CSS field label (background-clip): how far the background paints (border, padding or content box).

labels.css-properties.background-colour.note: CSS field label (background-color): fill colour behind the element's content.

labels.css-properties.background-image.note: CSS field label (background-image): an image or gradient painted behind the element.

labels.css-properties.background-origin.note: CSS field label (background-origin): the box the background position is measured from.

labels.css-properties.background-positio.note: CSS field label (background-position): where the background image sits in the element.

labels.css-properties.background-repeat.note: CSS field label (background-repeat): whether the background image tiles.

labels.css-properties.background-size.note: CSS field label (background-size): how large the background image is drawn.

labels.css-properties.backgrounds.note: Group heading (plural) for the background fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.bar.note: Group heading for the fields that style the tab bar's bar part (content area), not the progress bar module.

labels.css-properties.bar-background.note: Field label for the background of the whole tab bar strip, not a single tab.

labels.css-properties.bar-border-colour.note: Field label for the border colour of the whole tab bar strip; single tabs use Tab border colour.

labels.css-properties.bar-border-style.note: Field label for the border line style of the whole tab bar strip.

labels.css-properties.bar-border-width.note: Field label for the border thickness of the whole tab bar strip.

labels.css-properties.bar-padding.note: Field label for the space inside the tab bar strip around the tabs.

labels.css-properties.bar-position.note: Field label for which edge of the card the tab bar sits on (top, bottom, left, right).

labels.css-properties.below.note: Position option: the element sits below the other part (icon below text, state below label).

labels.css-properties.beside.note: Position option: the element sits next to the other part on the same line.

labels.css-properties.border.note: CSS field label for the border shorthand (width, style and colour in one value).

labels.css-properties.border-bottom.note: CSS field label (border-bottom): border on the bottom edge only.

labels.css-properties.border-collapse.note: CSS field label (border-collapse): whether table cell borders merge into one line.

labels.css-properties.border-colour.note: CSS field label (border-color): colour of an element's border; differs from Bar border colour and Tab border colour.

labels.css-properties.border-left.note: CSS field label (border-left): border on the left edge only; follows the page, not text direction.

labels.css-properties.border-length.note: Field label for how much of the edge the border line covers, such as 40% for a short accent line.

labels.css-properties.border-radius.note: CSS field label (border-radius): how round the corners are.

labels.css-properties.border-right.note: CSS field label (border-right): border on the right edge only.

labels.css-properties.border-spacing.note: CSS field label (border-spacing): gap between table cell borders.

labels.css-properties.border-style.note: CSS field label (border-style): line style of a border, such as solid or dashed.

labels.css-properties.border-top.note: CSS field label (border-top): border on the top edge only.

labels.css-properties.border-width.note: CSS field label (border-width): thickness of an element's border.

labels.css-properties.borders-outlines.note: Group heading for border and outline fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.both.note: Option applying to both directions or both sides (for example clear left and right).

labels.css-properties.bottom.note: Option or field label for the bottom edge (position offset or placement).

labels.css-properties.box-shadow.note: CSS field label (box-shadow): drop shadow around an element.

labels.css-properties.box-sizing.note: CSS field label (box-sizing): whether width and height include padding and border.

labels.css-properties.caption-side.note: CSS field label (caption-side): whether a table caption sits above or below the table.

labels.css-properties.centre.note: Alignment option: centred in the available space (not the text-align word centre of a sentence).

labels.css-properties.circle.note: Shape option: a round shape, used for the icon background or list marker.

labels.css-properties.clear.note: CSS field label (clear): which side an element must not sit next to a floated element; not a clear-value button.

labels.css-properties.colour.note: CSS field label (color): the text colour of an element.

labels.css-properties.column.note: Option for a vertical direction (flex-direction column), items stack top to bottom.

labels.css-properties.column-gap.note: CSS field label (column-gap): horizontal space between columns.

labels.css-properties.content-alignment.note: Field label for how the content inside a button or tab is aligned.

labels.css-properties.css-grid.note: Group heading for the CSS grid layout fields; keep the term CSS grid.

labels.css-properties.cursor.note: CSS field label (cursor): the mouse pointer shape shown over the element.

labels.css-properties.direction.note: CSS field label (flex-direction): whether children flow in a row or a column.

labels.css-properties.disabled-tabs.note: Group heading for the look of tabs that cannot be selected.

labels.css-properties.display.note: CSS field label (display): how the element lays out, such as block, flex or grid.

labels.css-properties.effects.note: Group heading for visual effect fields (shadow, opacity, filter) in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.end.note: Alignment option: items sit at the end of the axis (right in left-to-right text).

labels.css-properties.fade.note: Tab content switch animation option: the old content fades out as the new fades in.

labels.css-properties.fill-mode.note: CSS field label (animation-fill-mode): which animation styles stay before and after it plays.

labels.css-properties.filter.note: CSS field label (filter): visual filters such as blur or brightness on the element itself.

labels.css-properties.flex.note: CSS field label for the flex shorthand (grow, shrink and basis in one value).

labels.css-properties.flex-basis.note: CSS field label (flex-basis): starting size of a flex item before it grows or shrinks.

labels.css-properties.flex-grow.note: CSS field label (flex-grow): how much of the spare space a flex item takes.

labels.css-properties.flex-shrink.note: CSS field label (flex-shrink): how much a flex item gives up when space runs short.

labels.css-properties.flexbox.note: Group heading for the CSS flexbox layout fields; keep the term Flexbox.

labels.css-properties.float.note: CSS field label (float): push the element to one side so text wraps around it; not the animation preset Float.

labels.css-properties.font-family.note: CSS field label (font-family): the typeface used for text.

labels.css-properties.font-size.note: CSS field label (font-size): the size of text.

labels.css-properties.font-style.note: CSS field label (font-style): normal or italic text.

labels.css-properties.font-variant.note: CSS field label (font-variant): small caps and similar letter variants.

labels.css-properties.font-weight.note: CSS field label (font-weight): how bold the text is.

labels.css-properties.gap.note: CSS field label (gap): space between children of a flex or grid container.

labels.css-properties.gap-between-tabs.note: Field label for the space between neighbouring tab buttons in the tab bar.

labels.css-properties.height.note: CSS field label (height): how tall the element is.

labels.css-properties.hidden.note: Option that hides the element or clips overflowing content (CSS hidden).

labels.css-properties.icon.note: Group heading for the icon fields of a button or tab in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.icon-background.note: Field label for the fill colour of the shape behind a button's icon.

labels.css-properties.icon-background-sh.note: Field label for the shape behind a button's icon, such as circle or rounded.

labels.css-properties.icon-colour.note: Field label for the colour of a button's icon.

labels.css-properties.icon-gap.note: Field label for the space between a button's icon and its text.

labels.css-properties.icon-position.note: Field label for where a button's icon sits relative to its text (above, beside, below).

labels.css-properties.icon-size.note: Field label for the size of a button's icon.

labels.css-properties.icon-text.note: Group heading for the fields that style a button's icon and its text together.

labels.css-properties.ignored-when-the-v.text: Ignored when the viewer prefers reduced motion.
labels.css-properties.ignored-when-the-v.note: Hint under animation fields: the animation is skipped for viewers with a reduced-motion setting.

labels.css-properties.inset.note: CSS field label (inset): top, right, bottom and left offsets of a positioned element in one value.

labels.css-properties.iteration-count.note: CSS field label (animation-iteration-count): how many times the animation repeats.

labels.css-properties.justify-content.note: CSS field label (justify-content): how children share spare space along the main axis.

labels.css-properties.label-colour.note: Field label for the text colour of a button's label.

labels.css-properties.label-font-family.note: Field label for the typeface of a button's label.

labels.css-properties.label-font-size.note: Field label for the text size of a button's label.

labels.css-properties.label-font-weight.note: Field label for how bold a button's label is.

labels.css-properties.label-overflow.note: Field label for what happens when a button's label is too long: wrap, clip or truncate.

labels.css-properties.label-text-transfo.note: Field label for upper-case, lower-case or capitalised display of a button's label.

labels.css-properties.layout.note: Group heading for layout fields (display, direction, gap) in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.left.note: Option for the left side; it follows the text direction, so it flips in right-to-left languages.

labels.css-properties.left-and-right-fol.text: Left and right follow the text direction.
labels.css-properties.left-and-right-fol.note: Hint under a position field: left and right swap in right-to-left languages.

labels.css-properties.letter-spacing.note: CSS field label (letter-spacing): extra space between letters.

labels.css-properties.line-height.note: CSS field label (line-height): height of each line of text.

labels.css-properties.list-style.note: CSS field label for the list-style shorthand (marker type, position and image).

labels.css-properties.list-style-image.note: CSS field label (list-style-image): an image used as the list marker.

labels.css-properties.list-style-positio.note: CSS field label (list-style-position): whether the marker sits inside or outside the text.

labels.css-properties.list-style-type.note: CSS field label (list-style-type): the marker shape or numbering, such as disc or decimal.

labels.css-properties.lists-tables.note: Group heading for list and table fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.margin.note: CSS field label (margin): space outside the element's border.

labels.css-properties.max-height.note: CSS field label (max-height): the tallest the element may grow.

labels.css-properties.max-width.note: CSS field label (max-width): the widest the element may grow.

labels.css-properties.min-height.note: CSS field label (min-height): the shortest the element may shrink.

labels.css-properties.min-width.note: CSS field label (min-width): the narrowest the element may shrink.

labels.css-properties.none.note: Option meaning the property is switched off (CSS none), such as no border or no shadow.

labels.css-properties.none-or-up-to-two-.text: none, or up to two shadows, for example 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25).
labels.css-properties.none-or-up-to-two-.note: Hint under the Tab shadow field; keep none and the CSS example exactly as written.

labels.css-properties.normal-or-one-leng.text: normal, or one length, for example 0.05em.
labels.css-properties.normal-or-one-leng.note: Hint under the Tab letter spacing field; keep normal and the CSS example exactly as written.

labels.css-properties.offsets.note: Group heading for the top, right, bottom and left offset fields of a positioned element.

labels.css-properties.one-to-four-length.text: One to four lengths, for example 4px 8px.
labels.css-properties.one-to-four-length.note: Hint under the Tab padding field; keep the CSS example exactly as written.

labels.css-properties.opacity.note: CSS field label (opacity): how see-through the element is.

labels.css-properties.order.note: CSS field label (order): the position of a flex or grid item in its container.

labels.css-properties.outline.note: CSS field label for the outline shorthand: a line drawn outside the border that takes no space.

labels.css-properties.outline-colour.note: CSS field label (outline-color): colour of the outline.

labels.css-properties.outline-offset.note: CSS field label (outline-offset): gap between the border and the outline.

labels.css-properties.outline-style.note: CSS field label (outline-style): line style of the outline, such as solid or dashed.

labels.css-properties.outline-width.note: CSS field label (outline-width): thickness of the outline.

labels.css-properties.overflow.note: CSS field label (overflow): what happens to content that is larger than its box.

labels.css-properties.overflow-wrap.note: CSS field label (overflow-wrap): whether long words may break to fit the box.

labels.css-properties.overflow-x.note: CSS field label (overflow-x): overflow handling on the horizontal axis; X is the axis name.

labels.css-properties.overflow-y.note: CSS field label (overflow-y): overflow handling on the vertical axis; Y is the axis name.

labels.css-properties.padding.note: CSS field label (padding): space between the element's border and its content.

labels.css-properties.play-state.note: CSS field label (animation-play-state): whether the animation is running or paused.

labels.css-properties.plays-on-the-tab-b.text: Plays on the tab button. The content fade or slide is set under Bar.
labels.css-properties.plays-on-the-tab-b.note: Hint under the tab animation fields; Bar here is the group heading named Bar.

labels.css-properties.pointer-events.note: CSS field label (pointer-events): whether the element reacts to mouse and touch.

labels.css-properties.position.note: CSS field label (position): static, relative, absolute or fixed placement.

labels.css-properties.positioning-layout.note: Group heading for position, size and layout fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.right.note: Option for the right side; it follows the text direction, so it flips in right-to-left languages.

labels.css-properties.ring.note: Icon background shape option: a hollow circle outline with no fill.

labels.css-properties.rounded.note: Icon background shape option: a square with rounded corners.

labels.css-properties.row.note: Option for a horizontal direction (flex-direction row), items sit side by side.

labels.css-properties.row-gap.note: CSS field label (row-gap): vertical space between rows.

labels.css-properties.shape.note: Field label for the outline shape of an element, such as circle or rounded.

labels.css-properties.shorten-the-border.text: Shorten the border line, e.g. 40% for a short accent line.
labels.css-properties.shorten-the-border.note: Hint under the Border length field; keep the 40% example as written.

labels.css-properties.sides.note: Field label for which sides of the element a border applies to (top, right, bottom, left).

labels.css-properties.slide.note: Tab content switch animation option: the new content slides in from the side.

labels.css-properties.spacing-box-model.note: Group heading for margin, padding, size and box-sizing fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.start.note: Alignment option: items sit at the start of the axis (left in left-to-right text).

labels.css-properties.state-colour.note: Field label for the text colour of the entity state shown on a button.

labels.css-properties.state-font-size.note: Field label for the text size of the entity state shown on a button.

labels.css-properties.state-position.note: Field label for where the entity state sits relative to the button label (above, beside, below).

labels.css-properties.stretch.note: Alignment option: items grow to fill the cross axis; not the animation preset Stretch.

labels.css-properties.style.note: Field label for the line style of a border or outline (solid, dashed, dotted).

labels.css-properties.tab-alignment.note: Field label for how the tab buttons line up along the tab bar (start, centre, end, stretch).

labels.css-properties.tab-animations.note: Group heading for the animations that play on tab buttons.

labels.css-properties.tab-background.note: Field label for the background colour of a single tab button, not the whole bar.

labels.css-properties.tab-bar.note: Group heading for the fields that style the strip holding the tab buttons.

labels.css-properties.tab-border-colour.note: Field label for the border colour of a single tab button; the bar has Bar border colour.

labels.css-properties.tab-border-style.note: Field label for the border line style of a single tab button.

labels.css-properties.tab-border-width.note: Field label for the border thickness of a single tab button.

labels.css-properties.tab-corner-radius.note: Field label for how round the corners of a tab button are.

labels.css-properties.tab-font-family.note: Field label for the typeface of the text on tab buttons.

labels.css-properties.tab-font-size.note: Field label for the text size on tab buttons.

labels.css-properties.tab-font-weight.note: Field label for how bold the text on tab buttons is.

labels.css-properties.tab-icon-animation.note: Field label for the animation that plays on the icon of a tab button.

labels.css-properties.tab-icon-colour.note: Field label for the colour of the icon on a tab button.

labels.css-properties.tab-icon-position.note: Field label for where the icon sits relative to the text on a tab button.

labels.css-properties.tab-icon-size.note: Field label for the size of the icon on a tab button.

labels.css-properties.tab-letter-spacing.note: Field label for extra space between letters on tab buttons.

labels.css-properties.tab-opacity.note: Field label for how see-through a tab button is.

labels.css-properties.tab-padding.note: Field label for the space inside a tab button around its content.

labels.css-properties.tab-shadow.note: Field label for the drop shadow of a tab button.

labels.css-properties.tab-switch-animati.note: Field label for the animation that plays when the active tab changes.

labels.css-properties.tab-text-colour.note: Field label for the text colour on tab buttons.

labels.css-properties.tab-text-transform.note: Field label for upper-case, lower-case or capitalised text on tab buttons.

labels.css-properties.table-layout.note: CSS field label (table-layout): whether table columns size to content or stay fixed.

labels.css-properties.template-areas.note: CSS grid field label (grid-template-areas): named regions that make up the grid layout.

labels.css-properties.template-columns.note: CSS grid field label (grid-template-columns): the widths of the grid columns.

labels.css-properties.template-rows.note: CSS grid field label (grid-template-rows): the heights of the grid rows.

labels.css-properties.text.note: Group heading for the text fields (align, indent, decoration) in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.text-align.note: CSS field label (text-align): horizontal alignment of text inside its box.

labels.css-properties.text-decoration.note: CSS field label (text-decoration): underline, overline or strike-through on text.

labels.css-properties.text-indent.note: CSS field label (text-indent): indentation of the first line of text.

labels.css-properties.text-overflow.note: CSS field label (text-overflow): how text that does not fit is shown, such as an ellipsis.

labels.css-properties.text-shadow.note: CSS field label (text-shadow): drop shadow behind the letters.

labels.css-properties.text-transform.note: CSS field label (text-transform): upper-case, lower-case or capitalised display of text.

labels.css-properties.tick-the-tabs-that.text: Tick the tabs that cannot be opened.
labels.css-properties.tick-the-tabs-that.note: Hint above the checklist of tabs under Disabled tabs; a full sentence.

labels.css-properties.top.note: Option or field label for the top edge (position offset or placement).

labels.css-properties.transform.note: CSS field label (transform): rotate, scale, skew or move the element.

labels.css-properties.transform-origin.note: CSS field label (transform-origin): the pivot point for rotating and scaling.

labels.css-properties.transition.note: CSS field label for the transition shorthand: smooth change between two style values.

labels.css-properties.transition-delay.note: CSS field label (transition-delay): wait before a transition starts.

labels.css-properties.transition-duratio.note: CSS field label (transition-duration): how long a transition lasts.

labels.css-properties.transition-propert.note: CSS field label (transition-property): which style property a transition animates.

labels.css-properties.transition-timing.note: CSS field label (transition-timing-function): the easing curve of a transition.

labels.css-properties.transitions-animat.note: Group heading for transition, transform and animation fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.truncate.note: Label overflow option: cut a long label with an ellipsis (see the hint about tooltips).

labels.css-properties.typography.note: Group heading for font and text style fields in the CSS panel.

labels.css-properties.value-background.note: Field label for the background behind the entity value shown on a bar or button.

labels.css-properties.vertical-content-a.note: Field label for how content is aligned top to bottom inside a button or tab.

labels.css-properties.visibility.note: CSS field label (visibility): hide the element but keep its space.

labels.css-properties.white-space.note: CSS field label (white-space): how spaces and line breaks in text are handled.

labels.css-properties.width.note: CSS field label (width): how wide the element is.

labels.css-properties.word-break.note: CSS field label (word-break): where words may break when a line is full.

labels.css-properties.word-spacing.note: CSS field label (word-spacing): extra space between words.

labels.css-properties.wrap.note: CSS field label (flex-wrap): whether flex children move to a new line when space runs out.

labels.css-properties.z-index.note: CSS field label (z-index): stacking order, higher numbers sit in front.

labels.css-property-options.100.note: Font-weight option (number): 100 is the thinnest text. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.200.note: Font-weight option (number): 200 is extra-light text. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.300.note: Font-weight option (number): 300 is light text. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.400.note: Font-weight option (number): 400 is regular text, the same as Normal. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.500.note: Font-weight option (number): 500 is medium text. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.600.note: Font-weight option (number): 600 is semi-bold text. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.700.note: Font-weight option (number): 700 is bold text, the same as Bold. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.800.note: Font-weight option (number): 800 is extra-bold text. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.900.note: Font-weight option (number): 900 is the heaviest, black text. Keep the digits.

labels.css-property-options.absolute.note: Position option: the element is placed at exact offsets inside its parent, outside the normal flow.

labels.css-property-options.alternate.note: Animation-direction option: the animation plays forwards, then backwards, on each repeat.

labels.css-property-options.alternate-re.note: Animation-direction option: like Alternate, but the first run plays backwards.

labels.css-property-options.anywhere.note: Overflow-wrap option: a long word may break at any character to avoid overflowing.

labels.css-property-options.auto.note: Option shared by several CSS fields (overflow, z-index, cursor and others): the browser picks the value itself.

labels.css-property-options.backwards.note: Animation fill-mode option: the first frame applies during the delay, before the animation starts.

labels.css-property-options.baseline.note: Align-items option: items line up on the baseline of their text, not on an edge.

labels.css-property-options.block.note: Display option: the element takes a full-width line of its own, like a paragraph.

labels.css-property-options.bold.note: Font-weight option (word): heavy text, the same as 700. Not the Bold style button.

labels.css-property-options.border-box.note: Box-sizing option: width and height include the padding and the border. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.both.note: Option for animation fill-mode (apply the first and last frame) and for the clear field (both sides).

labels.css-property-options.bottom.note: Vertical-align or background-position option: align to the lower edge.

labels.css-property-options.break-all.note: Word-break option: lines may break between any two characters. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.break-spaces.note: White-space option: spaces are kept and lines may wrap at them. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.break-word.note: Word-break or overflow-wrap option: a long word breaks only when it would overflow.

labels.css-property-options.capitalize.note: Text-transform option: the first letter of every word becomes a capital.

labels.css-property-options.centre.note: Alignment option in the CSS fields (text-align, align-items, justify-content): centred. Not the animation preset.

labels.css-property-options.circle.note: List-style option: list items get a hollow round bullet.

labels.css-property-options.clip.note: Text-overflow or overflow option: content that does not fit is cut off without a sign.

labels.css-property-options.collapse.note: Border-collapse option: neighbouring table cells share one border line.

labels.css-property-options.column.note: Flex-direction or grid-auto-flow option: items are laid out top to bottom.

labels.css-property-options.column-dense.note: Grid-auto-flow option: fill columns first and back-fill gaps with later items.

labels.css-property-options.column-rever.note: Flex-direction option: items are laid out bottom to top.

labels.css-property-options.contain.note: Background-size or object-fit option: scale the image to fit entirely inside the box.

labels.css-property-options.content-box.note: Box-sizing option: width and height cover the content only, padding and border come on top. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.contents.note: Display option: the element's own box disappears and only its children are shown.

labels.css-property-options.cover.note: Background-size or object-fit option: scale the image to fill the box, cropping the overflow.

labels.css-property-options.crosshair.note: Cursor option: the mouse pointer turns into a precise cross.

labels.css-property-options.dashed.note: Border-style option: a line made of short dashes. Not the Dashed line style of a shape.

labels.css-property-options.decimal.note: List-style option: list items are numbered 1, 2, 3.

labels.css-property-options.default.note: Cursor option: the normal arrow pointer.

labels.css-property-options.dense.note: Grid-auto-flow option: back-fill earlier gaps in the grid with smaller items.

labels.css-property-options.disc.note: List-style option: list items get a solid round bullet.

labels.css-property-options.dotted.note: Border-style option: a line made of dots.

labels.css-property-options.double.note: Border-style or text-decoration option: two parallel lines. Not the Double rail slider look.

labels.css-property-options.ellipsis.note: Text-overflow option: cut-off text ends in three dots (...).

labels.css-property-options.fixed.note: Position or background-attachment option: stays put relative to the screen when the page scrolls.

labels.css-property-options.flex.note: Display option: the element becomes a flexible box that lays out its children. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.flex-end.note: Alignment option for flex layouts: items sit at the end of the axis (right or bottom, following direction).

labels.css-property-options.flex-start.note: Alignment option for flex layouts: items sit at the start of the axis (left or top, following direction).

labels.css-property-options.forwards.note: Animation fill-mode option: the last frame stays applied after the animation ends.

labels.css-property-options.grab.note: Cursor option: the pointer becomes an open hand, showing something can be dragged.

labels.css-property-options.grid.note: Display option: the element lays out its children in rows and columns. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.groove.note: Border-style option: a 3D border that looks carved into the page.

labels.css-property-options.hidden.note: Overflow or visibility option: content is not shown (overflow also clips it, with no scrolling).

labels.css-property-options.inline.note: Display option: the element flows within a line of text, like a word.

labels.css-property-options.inline-block.note: Display option: flows within a line of text but keeps a width and height of its own. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.inline-flex.note: Display option: a flexible box that sits within a line of text. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.inline-grid.note: Display option: a grid that sits within a line of text. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.inset.note: Border-style option: a 3D border that makes the box look pressed in.

labels.css-property-options.inside.note: List-style-position option: the bullet sits inside the text block.

labels.css-property-options.italic.note: Font-style option: slanted text using the italic design of the font.

labels.css-property-options.justify.note: Text-align option: lines are stretched so both edges are flush.

labels.css-property-options.keep-all.note: Word-break option: no breaks inside Chinese, Japanese or Korean text. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.left.note: Text-align or float option: the left edge. In CSS it is always left, not the start of the text direction.

labels.css-property-options.line-through.note: Text-decoration option: a line struck through the middle of the text.

labels.css-property-options.local.note: Background-attachment option: the background scrolls with the content of the element.

labels.css-property-options.lower-alpha.note: List-style option: list items are lettered a, b, c.

labels.css-property-options.lower-roman.note: List-style option: list items use lower-case Roman numerals i, ii, iii.

labels.css-property-options.lowercase.note: Text-transform option: all letters are shown in lower case.

labels.css-property-options.move.note: Cursor option: the pointer becomes a four-way arrow, showing something can be moved.

labels.css-property-options.no-repeat.note: Background-repeat option: the background image is drawn once and not tiled.

labels.css-property-options.none.note: Option shared by several CSS fields (display, border-style, text-decoration, float): switches the feature off.

labels.css-property-options.normal.note: Option shared by several CSS fields (font-style, font-weight, white-space, letter-spacing): the standard setting.

labels.css-property-options.not-allowed.note: Cursor option: the pointer shows a forbidden sign over something that cannot be used.

labels.css-property-options.nowrap.note: White-space or flex-wrap option: everything stays on one line. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.oblique.note: Font-style option: text slanted by the browser, close to italic but not a separate font design.

labels.css-property-options.outset.note: Border-style option: a 3D border that makes the box look raised.

labels.css-property-options.outside.note: List-style-position option: the bullet hangs outside the text block.

labels.css-property-options.overline.note: Text-decoration option: a line drawn above the text.

labels.css-property-options.padding-box.note: Background-clip option: the background stops at the padding edge, under the border. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.paused.note: Animation-play-state option: the animation is stopped at its current frame.

labels.css-property-options.pointer.note: Cursor option: the pointer becomes a hand with a finger, showing something can be clicked.

labels.css-property-options.pre.note: White-space option, short for preformatted: spaces and line breaks are kept as typed. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.pre-line.note: White-space option: line breaks are kept, runs of spaces are merged. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.pre-wrap.note: White-space option: spaces and line breaks are kept and long lines still wrap. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.relative.note: Position option: the element stays in the normal flow and can be nudged from its usual place.

labels.css-property-options.repeat.note: Background-repeat option: the background image is tiled in both directions.

labels.css-property-options.repeat-x.note: Background-repeat option: the image is tiled horizontally only. Keep the x.

labels.css-property-options.repeat-y.note: Background-repeat option: the image is tiled vertically only. Keep the y.

labels.css-property-options.reverse.note: Animation-direction option: the animation always plays backwards.

labels.css-property-options.ridge.note: Border-style option: a 3D border that looks raised, the opposite of Groove.

labels.css-property-options.right.note: Text-align or float option: the right edge. In CSS it is always right, not the end of the text direction.

labels.css-property-options.round.note: Background-repeat option: tiles are resized so a whole number of them fits. Not the Round node shape.

labels.css-property-options.row.note: Flex-direction or grid-auto-flow option: items are laid out left to right.

labels.css-property-options.row-dense.note: Grid-auto-flow option: fill rows first and back-fill gaps with later items.

labels.css-property-options.row-reverse.note: Flex-direction option: items are laid out right to left.

labels.css-property-options.running.note: Animation-play-state option: the animation plays normally.

labels.css-property-options.scroll.note: Overflow option: content that does not fit can be scrolled. Also a background-attachment option.

labels.css-property-options.separate.note: Border-collapse option: each table cell keeps its own border.

labels.css-property-options.space.note: Background-repeat option: tiles keep their size and the leftover room is spread between them.

labels.css-property-options.space-around.note: Justify-content option: free room is shared around items, with half-size gaps at the ends. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.space-betwee.note: Justify-content option: free room goes between items, with none at the ends. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.space-evenly.note: Justify-content option: free room is split into equal gaps, including at the ends. Keep the CSS term.

labels.css-property-options.square.note: List-style option: list items get a square bullet. Not the Square shape in the look editor.

labels.css-property-options.static.note: Position option: the default, normal flow with no offsets applied.

labels.css-property-options.sticky.note: Position option: the element scrolls normally, then sticks at an edge once it reaches it.

labels.css-property-options.stretch.note: Align-items or align-content option: items grow to fill the space. Not the Stretch animation preset.

labels.css-property-options.text.note: Cursor option: the pointer becomes the I-beam, showing text can be selected.

labels.css-property-options.top.note: Vertical-align or background-position option: align to the upper edge.

labels.css-property-options.underline.note: Text-decoration option: a line drawn under the text.

labels.css-property-options.upper-alpha.note: List-style option: list items are lettered A, B, C.

labels.css-property-options.upper-roman.note: List-style option: list items use upper-case Roman numerals I, II, III.

labels.css-property-options.uppercase.note: Text-transform option: all letters are shown in capitals.

labels.css-property-options.visible.note: Overflow or visibility option: content is shown, and overflowing content spills out of the box.

labels.css-property-options.wait.note: Cursor option: the pointer shows a busy symbol, such as an hourglass or spinner.

labels.css-property-options.wrap.note: Flex-wrap option: items move on to a new line when they run out of room.

labels.css-property-options.wrap-reverse.note: Flex-wrap option: items wrap onto new lines placed in the opposite order.

labels.device-anim.drum-while-cleaning.note: Option describing a device animation: the washing-machine drum spins while the cleaning cycle runs.

labels.device-anim.drum-while-running.note: Option describing a device animation: the appliance drum spins while the device state is running.

labels.device-anim.drum-while-the-state-.text: Drum while the state is running, washing or drying
labels.device-anim.drum-while-the-state-.note: Description of a device animation: the drum spins whenever the entity state is running, washing or drying.

labels.device-anim.equalizer-while-playi.note: Description of a device animation for media players: equalizer bars move while the player is playing.

labels.device-anim.flame-while-heating-s.text: Flame while heating, Snow while cooling, Spin while only the fan runs
labels.device-anim.flame-while-heating-s.note: Description of a climate device animation. Flame, Snow and Spin are animation preset names, so keep them in line with those translations.

labels.device-anim.glow-while-on-in-the-.text: Glow while on, in the light's colour and brightness
labels.device-anim.glow-while-on-in-the-.note: Description of a light device animation: a glow while the light is on, matching its colour and brightness.

labels.device-anim.pulse-in-the-alert-co.text: Pulse in the alert colour while triggered
labels.device-anim.pulse-in-the-alert-co.note: Description of an alarm device animation: it pulses in the alert colour while the alarm is triggered.

labels.device-anim.pulse-in-the-alert-co.text: Pulse in the alert colour while on
labels.device-anim.pulse-in-the-alert-co.note: Description of a sensor device animation: it pulses in the alert colour while the sensor is on.

labels.device-anim.shake-while-jammed-pu.text: Shake while jammed, Pulse while locking or unlocking
labels.device-anim.shake-while-jammed-pu.note: Description of a lock device animation. Shake and Pulse are animation preset names, so keep them in line with those translations.

labels.device-anim.spin-while-on-faster-.text: Spin while on, faster at a higher speed
labels.device-anim.spin-while-on-faster-.note: Description of a fan device animation: it spins while on and spins faster at a higher speed setting.

labels.device-anim.swing-a-slightly-open.text: Swing: a slightly opened pose while open
labels.device-anim.swing-a-slightly-open.note: Description of a device animation: the icon holds a slightly opened pose while open. Swing is an animation preset name.

labels.device-anim.swing-while-opening-o.text: Swing while opening or closing, a slightly opened pose while open
labels.device-anim.swing-while-opening-o.note: Description of a door or cover device animation: it swings while opening or closing, then holds a slightly opened pose.

labels.field-reset.reset-label.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the reset icon beside a field. {label} is the field's label, for example 'Border radius'.

vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.

labels.field-reset.reset-to-default.note: Tooltip of the reset icon beside a field that has been changed: puts the field back to its default value.

labels.horizontal-module.arrange-child-m.text: Arrange child modules in a row
labels.horizontal-module.arrange-child-m.note: Description of the Horizontal layout module in the module picker: the modules inside sit side by side.

labels.horizontal-module.horizontal.note: Name of the layout module that places its child modules side by side. Pairs with Vertical.

labels.icon-doc.part-n.note: Default name of one piece of an icon drawing. {n} is its position, starting at 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

labels.icon-module.display-an-icon-from-.text: Display an icon from MDI or entity
labels.icon-module.display-an-icon-from-.note: Description of the Icon module in the module picker. MDI is Material Design Icons; keep the abbreviation.

labels.icon-module.icon.note: Name of the module that shows a single icon, listed in the module picker and the tree.

labels.info-module.display-entity-name-s.text: Display entity name, state, and attributes
labels.info-module.display-entity-name-s.note: Description of the Info module in the module picker: it shows an entity's name, state and attributes.

labels.info-module.info.note: Name of the module that shows an entity's name, state and attributes, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.arc-gauge-for-displ.text: Arc gauge for displaying numeric sensor values
labels.lazy-metadata.arc-gauge-for-displ.note: Description of the Gauge module in the module picker: a curved dial for a number such as a temperature.

labels.lazy-metadata.arrange-child-modul.text: Arrange child modules in a slider
labels.lazy-metadata.arrange-child-modul.note: Description of the Slider layout module in the module picker: the child modules become slides to swipe through.

labels.lazy-metadata.camera.note: Name of the module that shows a camera entity's stream, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.clock.note: Name of the module that shows the current time and date, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.custom-card.note: Name of the module that embeds another Lovelace card, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.display-a-camera-en.note: Description of the Camera module in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.display-a-static-im.text: Display a static image or entity picture
labels.lazy-metadata.display-a-static-im.note: Description of the Image module in the module picker: a fixed image or an entity's picture.

labels.lazy-metadata.display-current-tim.note: Description of the Clock module in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.display-entity-hist.text: Display entity history as a line graph
labels.lazy-metadata.display-entity-hist.note: Description of the Graph module in the module picker: past values of an entity drawn as a line.

labels.lazy-metadata.display-weather-ent.note: Description of the Weather module in the module picker: current conditions from a weather entity.

labels.lazy-metadata.display-weather-for.note: Description of the Forecast module in the module picker: upcoming weather, not current conditions.

labels.lazy-metadata.dropdown.note: Name of the module that lets people choose one option from a list, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.embed-any-3rd-party.note: Description of the Custom card module in the module picker. Lovelace is the Home Assistant dashboard; keep the name.

labels.lazy-metadata.forecast.note: Name of the module that shows the weather forecast, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.gauge.note: Name of the module that shows a number on a curved dial, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.graph.note: Name of the module that draws an entity's history as a line, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.image.note: Name of the module that shows a picture, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.light.note: Name of the module that controls a light entity, listed in the module picker. Not the light colour theme.

labels.lazy-metadata.light-control-with-.text: Light control with brightness, colour temperature, and colour options
labels.lazy-metadata.light-control-with-.note: Description of the Light module in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.markdown.note: Name of the module that renders Markdown-formatted text, listed in the module picker. Keep Markdown untranslated.

labels.lazy-metadata.numeric-input-with-.text: Numeric input with increment and decrement buttons
labels.lazy-metadata.numeric-input-with-.note: Description of the Spinbox module in the module picker: a number field with plus and minus buttons.

labels.lazy-metadata.range-slider-for-co.text: Range slider for controlling numeric values
labels.lazy-metadata.range-slider-for-co.note: Description of the Slider module in the module picker: drag a handle to set a number.

labels.lazy-metadata.render-markdown-for.note: Description of the Markdown module in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.select-dropdown-for.text: Select dropdown for choosing from a list of options
labels.lazy-metadata.select-dropdown-for.note: Description of the Dropdown module in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.slider.note: Name of the module with a draggable handle that sets a number, listed in the module picker. Not Slider layout.

labels.lazy-metadata.slider-layout.note: Name of the layout module that shows its child modules as swipeable slides. Not the value Slider.

labels.lazy-metadata.spinbox.note: Name of the number field with plus and minus buttons, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.tabbed-container-fo.text: Tabbed container for groups of modules
labels.lazy-metadata.tabbed-container-fo.note: Description of the Tabs module in the module picker: each tab holds its own group of modules.

labels.lazy-metadata.tabs.note: Name of the layout module that groups other modules under tab buttons, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.video-background.note: Name of the module that plays a video behind other modules, listed in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.video-playing-behin.text: Video playing behind the other modules of its column or layout
labels.lazy-metadata.video-playing-behin.note: Description of the Video background module in the module picker.

labels.lazy-metadata.weather.note: Name of the module that shows current weather conditions, listed in the module picker.

labels.part-presets.blink.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part switches off and on quickly.

labels.part-presets.blinks-twice.note: Description of the Blink part preset: it blinks two times, then rests.

labels.part-presets.bounce.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part hops up and lands again.

labels.part-presets.delay.note: Field label for a part preset setting: how long the part waits before its animation starts.

labels.part-presets.direction.note: Field label for a part preset setting: 1 plays the effect forwards, -1 plays it the other way.

labels.part-presets.draw-loop.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the outline draws on, holds and draws off in a loop.

labels.part-presets.draw-on.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the outline is drawn as if by pen, then the part fills in.

labels.part-presets.draws-its-outline-th.text: Draws its outline, then fills (direction -1 draws it off)
labels.part-presets.draws-its-outline-th.note: Description of the Draw on part preset. Direction is the field of that name; keep -1 as written.

labels.part-presets.draws-on-holds-and-d.text: Draws on, holds, and draws off again
labels.part-presets.draws-on-holds-and-d.note: Description of the Draw loop part preset.

labels.part-presets.drifts-up-and-down.note: Description of the Float part preset: the part moves gently up and down.

labels.part-presets.duration-share.note: Field label for a part preset setting: the part of the whole animation time this effect takes, as a fraction.

labels.part-presets.fade.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part becomes see-through and returns.

labels.part-presets.fades-out-and-back-i.note: Description of the Fade part preset.

labels.part-presets.flicker.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: brightness jitters unevenly, like a flame.

labels.part-presets.flickers-like-a-flam.note: Description of the Flicker part preset.

labels.part-presets.float.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part drifts up and down. Not the CSS float option.

labels.part-presets.grows-and-shrinks-ba.note: Description of the Pulse part preset. Direction is the field of that name; keep -1 as written.

labels.part-presets.intensity.note: Field label for a part preset setting: how strong the effect is.

labels.part-presets.lights-up-one-part-a.text: Lights up one part after another (on a group or several parts)
labels.part-presets.lights-up-one-part-a.note: Description of the Wave part preset: it needs a group or several selected parts, which glow in turn.

labels.part-presets.moves-down-and-back.note: Description of the Slide down part preset.

labels.part-presets.moves-left-and-back.note: Description of the Slide left part preset. Left is the screen side.

labels.part-presets.moves-right-and-back.note: Description of the Slide right part preset. Right is the screen side.

labels.part-presets.moves-up-and-back.note: Description of the Slide up part preset.

labels.part-presets.pop.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part appears from nothing with a small overshoot.

labels.part-presets.pops-in-from-nothing.text: Pops in from nothing with an overshoot
labels.part-presets.pops-in-from-nothing.note: Description of the Pop part preset.

labels.part-presets.pulse.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part grows and shrinks back in a steady rhythm.

labels.part-presets.ring.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: it rings like a bell. Not the Ring shape or the ring corner.

labels.part-presets.rings-like-a-bell-qu.text: Rings like a bell: quick swings that die down
labels.part-presets.rings-like-a-bell-qu.note: Description of the Ring part preset.

labels.part-presets.rocks-on-its-base.note: Description of the Wobble part preset: it tilts from side to side around its bottom.

labels.part-presets.shake.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part moves quickly from side to side.

labels.part-presets.shakes-from-side-to-.note: Description of the Shake part preset.

labels.part-presets.slide-down.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part moves down and returns.

labels.part-presets.slide-left.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part moves to the screen's left and returns.

labels.part-presets.slide-right.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part moves to the screen's right and returns.

labels.part-presets.slide-up.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part moves up and returns.

labels.part-presets.spin.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part turns round continuously.

labels.part-presets.squashes-jumps-and-l.note: Description of the Bounce part preset.

labels.part-presets.swing.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part swings from its top like a pendulum.

labels.part-presets.swings-from-its-top-.text: Swings from its top, settling back
labels.part-presets.swings-from-its-top-.note: Description of the Swing part preset.

labels.part-presets.turns.note: Field label for a part preset setting: how many whole turns the part makes per cycle.

labels.part-presets.turns-round-at-a-ste.text: Turns round at a steady speed (whole turns per cycle, so it loops seamlessly)
labels.part-presets.turns-round-at-a-ste.note: Description of the Spin part preset. Turns is the field of that name.

labels.part-presets.wave.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: a group of parts lights up one after another.

labels.part-presets.wobble.note: Name of an icon-part animation preset: the part rocks from side to side on its base.

labels.row-module.grid-row-with-columns-.text: Grid row with columns, nestable inside any column
labels.row-module.grid-row-with-columns-.note: Description of the Row module in the module picker: a row split into columns that can sit inside another column.

labels.row-module.row.note: Name of the layout module that holds columns, listed in the module picker. Not the Row flex-direction option.

labels.seasonal-labels.autumn.note: Name of a season in a seasonal choice list. British English: Autumn, not Fall.

labels.seasonal-labels.christmas.note: Name of a holiday in a seasonal choice list, used for a festive theme or effect.

labels.seasonal-labels.cloudy.note: Name of a weather condition in a seasonal choice list: an overcast sky.

labels.seasonal-labels.dusk.note: Name of a time of day in a seasonal choice list: the evening twilight.

labels.seasonal-labels.easter.note: Name of a holiday in a seasonal choice list, used for a spring festive theme or effect.

labels.seasonal-labels.fog.note: Name of a weather condition in a seasonal choice list: misty, low visibility.

labels.seasonal-labels.halloween.note: Name of a holiday in a seasonal choice list, used for a spooky theme or effect.

labels.seasonal-labels.new-year.note: Name of a holiday in a seasonal choice list: the turn of the year, with a party feel.

labels.seasonal-labels.night.note: Name of a time of day in a seasonal choice list: a dark sky with stars.

labels.seasonal-labels.rain.note: Name of a weather condition in a seasonal choice list: falling rain.

labels.seasonal-labels.snow.note: Name of a weather condition in a seasonal choice list: falling snow. Also an animation preset elsewhere.

labels.seasonal-labels.spring.note: Name of a season in a seasonal choice list. The season, not the coil or the verb.

labels.seasonal-labels.summer.note: Name of a season in a seasonal choice list.

labels.seasonal-labels.sunny.note: Name of a weather condition in a seasonal choice list: a clear, bright sky.

labels.seasonal-labels.thunderstorm.note: Name of a weather condition in a seasonal choice list: storm with lightning.

labels.seasonal-labels.valentine.note: Name of a holiday in a seasonal choice list: Valentine's Day, with a romantic theme.

labels.seasonal-labels.windy.note: Name of a weather condition in a seasonal choice list: strong wind.

labels.seasonal-labels.winter.note: Name of a season in a seasonal choice list.

labels.separator-module.separator.note: Name of the module that draws a dividing line between other modules, listed in the module picker.

labels.separator-module.visual-divider-b.note: Description of the Separator module in the module picker.

labels.text-module.display-static-or-tem.note: Description of the Text module in the module picker: fixed text or text built from a template.

labels.text-module.text.note: Name of the module that shows fixed or templated text, listed in the module picker. Not the Text cursor option.

labels.vertical-module.arrange-child-mod.text: Arrange child modules in a column
labels.vertical-module.arrange-child-mod.note: Description of the Vertical layout module in the module picker: the modules inside are stacked.

labels.vertical-module.vertical.note: Name of the layout module that stacks its child modules top to bottom. Pairs with Horizontal.
